caption: The drawing depicts a textile design featuring a decorative panel with a fringed edge. The composition is divided into several vertical sections. The outermost sections are bright red with long red fringe at the top and bottom. Next to each red section is a black vertical strip adorned with a floral motif, including red roses, purple flowers, green leaves, and birds. The central section is dominated by a large purple area with a vertical beige band displaying a geometric Greek key pattern running through it. In the middle of the textile is a rectangular grey panel with an image of a brown horse standing on green grass, with a red and purple decorative harness. The horse is detailed, showing a mane, tail, and hooves, with a saddle and other embellishments. The overall composition combines geometric designs and naturalistic imagery. In the lower right corner, there is a small rectangular inset containing a red and white geometric pattern, and some inscription is present beneath it.
title: Afghan Carriage Robe
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
